name: Poland

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, white over red.
flag.symbolism: The colors come from Poland's coat of arms, a white eagle on a red field.

hook: Poland puts white on top like snow over red; Indonesia and Monaco flip it to red over white.
trivia: Poland celebrates Flag Day on 2 May, between Labour Day and Constitution Day.
Upside down, the Polish flag looks almost exactly like the flags of Indonesia and Monaco.
